tasks.short: Analyze traffic or waveforms for unusual patterns

steps.what: Select traffic or waveform evidence and define analytical measures
Calculate specified traffic summaries or waveform measures in the analysis tool
Analyze unusual events or trends and test alternative explanations
Document anomaly findings, provenance and limits

tasks.design: Configure {OTHER} native analysis jobs to calculate only analyst-selected measures from preserved captures. The analyst interprets patterns and records their limits in {DOCS}; a numerical outlier does not establish malicious activity or a forensic cause.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated analysis can require reconstructing the same filters and numeric summaries.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved operations can reuse explicit source and measure parameters.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling limits, incomplete captures and a benign explanation for an unusual pattern.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst distinguishes a measured difference from an evidential conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated measure setup while anomaly interpretation remains human.

reach.task: Assess relevance of an unusual traffic pattern
reach.learn: Explain observation, baseline and uncertainty separately

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: analysis tools can replay fixed traffic or waveform calculations, while anomaly significance requires context and alternative explanations.

assumptions: Boundary is analysis of already authorised captures, excluding acquisition, active probing and formal legal reporting. Traffic and waveform work are alternative cases.

Existing acquisition process supplies preserved capture and provenance. Analyst records source ID, time window, schema, units and selected measures in s1's 25 hours; traffic mappings include available event timestamps and byte or event fields, while waveform mappings include sample rate and amplitude units. Unsupported fields or missing metadata stop processing for manual examination; no anomaly or maliciousness flag is presumed.
Test native saved analysis operations before custom code; s2's 30% requires observed repeated manual setup or tabulation, not existing calculation runtime.
All interpretation, alternative-explanation checks and evidence limitations retain their time.
research_questions: Can saved calculations reproduce manual summaries while making source and sampling gaps visible?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70, gross=30 and net=22 after eight upkeep hours. Range assumes repeated manual measure setup; source assessment and anomaly interpretation retain their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop data collection, processing and reporting requirements

steps.what: Clarify collection purposes, authority, stakeholders and data-handling constraints
Decide proposed collection, processing and reporting requirements
Draft the policy or requirements document from the proposed decisions

loop.purpose: Draft prose expressing supplied data-handling decisions
loop.input: Analyst-selected decisions, constraints, authority references and policy structure
loop.output: One draft with source-linked requirements and unresolved items clearly marked
loop.check: Analyst checks each obligation against the chosen decision, verifies that purpose and handling limits remain intact and identifies any invented permission or expanded collection scope
loop.stop: One draft; missing authority, contradictory requirements or invented obligations return to manual writing; no policy approval or activation
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native templates first; expressing a new set of interdependent requirements may need semantic drafting beyond field substitution

steps.what: Validate the proposed policy and route unresolved requirements to responsible owners

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} templates and a bounded prose draft only after the analyst has formulated the proposed handling requirements. The analyst and responsible owners validate the proposal; a generated sentence cannot grant data-collection authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policy prose can take time even after the substantive requirements are chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can express those chosen requirements for review.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing operational use, evidential needs and applicable authority.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst recognises when a requirement is infeasible or exceeds the intended purpose.
tasks.altitude: Less first-pass policy writing while purpose and handling decisions remain human.

reach.learn: Describe purpose, scope and unresolved authority precisely

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a model can draft policy prose from supplied decisions but cannot establish data-handling authority or legal applicability.

assumptions: Boundary is developing a proposal, excluding formal policy approval, implementation and case-specific handling. National and sector requirements are confirmed locally.

Analyst captures purpose, data categories, source, responsible owner, access, proposed retention or reporting constraints and authority references in s1's 35 hours, then makes explicit proposed decisions in s2's 25 hours. Existing governance owner supplies applicable rules; missing authority is referred manually, never inferred as permitted.
Test native policy templates before model drafting; existing document runtime earns no saving.
Existing stakeholder review is retained; additional legal review beyond current practice must be costed before expanding scope.
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting reduce writing effort after counting every invented or expanded obligation removed?

already_counted.description: Purpose, constraints and substantive requirements capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10 and net=5 after five upkeep hours. Range assumes some useful first-draft prose; all substantive requirement decisions and validation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select research and experience supporting the cyber defense recommendations
Write the recommendations, report or white-paper draft from the selected evidence

loop.purpose: Draft recommendations confined to supplied evidence and experience
loop.input: Selected source passages, analyst's documented experience, proposed recommendations and audience brief
loop.output: One draft with every factual assertion tied to supplied evidence and uncertainties preserved
loop.check: Analyst resolves each reference, checks that sources support the recommendation rather than merely mention the topic, and verifies that no statistic or experience claim was invented
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported claims, fabricated references or overgeneralised experience return to manual writing; no publication
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide structure first; synthesising selected evidence into explanatory recommendations requires prose reasoning beyond fixed fields

steps.what: Verify recommendations and hand over the checked manuscript

tasks.design: Use a bounded {DOCS} draft from the analyst's evidence and proposed recommendations. The analyst checks source support and approves the internal manuscript handover; public publication remains with the responsible owner.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expressing selected research and experience coherently can require repeated first-draft writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can supply a first manuscript for expert editing.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible recommendation may exceed what the evidence supports.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst judges relevance and recognises the limits of personal experience.
tasks.altitude: Less initial prose writing while evidence and recommendation responsibility stay human.

reach.learn: Separate supported action from uncertain extrapolation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound prose drafting can help write recommendations, but expert checks must establish that each source supports the proposed action.

assumptions: Boundary is a defence recommendation manuscript, excluding formal forensic case reports, internal findings summaries and public publication; overlapping writing is allocated once.

Analyst captures source identity and passages, experience record references, intended recommendations, audience and limitations in s1's 40 hours. Publishers and existing analyst records supply original material; unsupported claims are withheld or resolved manually, not replaced with generated citations.
Use native writing templates and existing material before a model; current document runtime earns no saving.
Confidential experience is used only with locally approved access and redaction, counted in s1.
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting reduce manuscript effort after counting unsupported claims and references corrected?

already_counted.description: Evidence selection, recommendation and audience capture

approvals.approved_version: Exact manuscript version, recommendations, references, limitations and permitted internal audience checked in s3; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=86, gross=14 and net=9 after five upkeep hours. Range assumes useful first-draft prose; evidence selection and recommendation judgement retain their time.

steps.what: Identify tool needs and evaluate existing reverse-engineering capabilities
Develop a candidate tool change for the specified analysis need

loop.purpose: Draft residual custom analysis-tool implementation for review
loop.input: Explicit tool specification, selected interfaces and non-sensitive representative lab data
loop.output: One candidate change in an isolated development branch
loop.check: Analyst checks intended outputs against independent examples, verifies handling of malformed inputs and confirms the tool does not silently alter evidence or overstate an observation
loop.stop: One candidate; unsupported interfaces, unexplained output or failed independent examples return to manual development; no deployment or operation on originals
loop.why_not_simpler: Evaluate existing approved tools and native extensions first; a model is considered only for remaining custom code

steps.what: Validate the tool on lab copies and document capability limits

tasks.design: Use existing {OTHER} reverse-engineering capabilities before developing a custom extension. For residual work, draft one candidate in isolation and validate it against independent lab examples; the tool's output is an observation to assess, not a vulnerability conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: A particular authorised analysis need may not be covered by an existing tool.
tasks.enabler_now: Coding assistance can provide first-pass implementation for review.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected formats and plausible but incorrect analytical output.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can determine whether output corresponds to the actual underlying artefact.
tasks.altitude: Less first-pass custom code while capability selection and validation remain human.

reach.learn: Specify expected outputs and malformed-input behaviour

evidence.claim: GitHub Copilot provides code completion and review with expected oversight; that supports candidate custom implementation, not forensic validity or vulnerability detection accuracy.
Model knowledge: analysis tools need independent expected-output checks on representative data before findings can rely on them.

assumptions: Boundary is authorised tool evaluation and development on lab copies, excluding live exploitation, production deployment and substantive case conclusions. Selection-only cases have no custom coding saving.

Analyst captures permitted analysis scope, input format, expected output semantics, interface versions and independent examples in s1's 50 hours. Existing lab owner supplies authorised copies; missing expected behaviour stops drafting for manual clarification rather than a generated works-correctly flag.
Test existing approved tools and extensions before custom code; existing execution runtime earns no saving.
Drafting has no original evidence write access or production credentials; validation work is fully retained.
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting reduce custom tool effort after counting incorrect analytical output and rejected code?

already_counted.description: Tool evaluation, scope and expected-output capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91, gross=9 and net=4 after five upkeep hours. Range assumes some useful custom-code drafting; existing-tool evaluation and independent validation keep their time.

role.altitude: Reduce repeated numeric processing and first drafts while retaining interpretation, data-handling authority and independent tool validation.
reach: Explain evidence-backed defence recommendations to engineers
Specify analytical tool outputs for developers
role.ambitious_version: A forensic analyst who can reproduce technical work and explain every resulting claim without delegating evidential judgement.
